title: review follow-ups of PR #37905: the object picker's refusal still says "No object chosen" while it keeps the stored target
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzpqH1nQTsbGckLspg

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · L1 nit on PR #37905 (#36747), L1-a record 7217191362 ("Nit, not blocking"); filed by zone `o3-build` on seat repo:objectstack#3's word.

## What happens (after PR #37905)
With `objectsOnly`, `ObjectPicker.commitTyped` now treats typed text that names no listed object as a refusal: the input goes back to the stored value and nothing is committed (PR #37905, rework round 1). But the refusal line still reads `engine.inspector.objectPicker.notChosen`:
- en (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts:1669`): "No object chosen: “{text}” is not an object. Choose one from the list."
- zh (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts:1497`): 「未选择对象：“{text}”不是对象。请从列表中选择一个。」

On a Lookup or roll-up field that already has a target (say `account`), typing `acount` shows "No object chosen" while the box shows `account` and the field keeps it. The text contradicts what the picker did.

## Done when
- When a stored target is kept, the refusal says the typed text is not an object and the current object is kept (en and zh). For example: "“{text}” is not an object; the current object is kept." The empty-field case keeps today's "No object chosen" text.
- A pin per case (kept target / empty field) asserts the rendered line in en and zh; one ablation.

reach: Studio field inspector, Lookup *Related object* and roll-up *Child object* doors, read from source at PR #37905's head 0009f822 (L1 record 7217191362); not yet in a browser.
Business reason: right after Studio stopped erasing a target on a typo, the message tells the builder the target is gone when it is not, so they re-pick an object that was never lost.
Dedupe: `notChosen` → 0 open; `"No object chosen"` → 0 open.
Blocked-by: #37905
Suggested-grade: p3 · area:build · Bug · builders, sometimes (copy only; the saved metadata is right).
